data.narrative:
ARX Robotics is a Series A defense & security robotics company founded by Marc Wietfeld that has raised $51.15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A/B stages, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $51M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage appreciation, implying $102M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set yields a $1.0B median valuation, with a range of $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). Representative Series B peers in the set include Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, and Code Metal at $1.2B.

These methods produce a triangulated range of $87M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $551M. The wide spread reflects material stage and progress variance within the peer set. Key uncertainties include ARX's specific product maturity, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the cited peer cohort—factors not quantified in available data. A Series A posting would likely fall toward the lower end of this range absent clear differentiation in technical capability or customer commitments.
